scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:python: python -m ruff check --no-cache app/main.py app/guard.py app/rag.py app/local_embeddings.py tests tools/build-demo-gif.py
scripts.format: python -m ruff format --no-cache app/main.py app/guard.py app/rag.py app/local_embeddings.py tests tools/build-demo-gif.py && prettier --write app/web/index.html app/web/app.js app/web/app.css eslint.config.js package.json .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format:check: python -m ruff format --check --no-cache app/main.py app/guard.py app/rag.py app/local_embeddings.py tests tools/build-demo-gif.py && prettier --check app/web/index.html app/web/app.js app/web/app.css eslint.config.js package.json .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run format:check && python -m compileall -q app tests
